text.section: Prior to the application of fumigant at the site, a facility shall post visible and legible signs at the facility fence or property line closest to any public right-of-way. The signs shall remain in place until completion of the aeration process and shall conform to the format for placards mandated by the federally approved fumigant label.
In-transit fumigations where the planned aeration is scheduled to occur outside of the Commonwealth are not subject to Board regulations.
